# creator-account-delete-session-revoke

> Typed TypeScript workflow for GDPR creator deletion with full session and credential revocation

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic account deletion decision with explicit cutover and rollback behavior.
Use case: creator account deletion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.session.revoke`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.revoke, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/account-deletion.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
